name: Portfolio
description: Personal portfolio website with Polish and English versions, project filtering, and light and dark themes.
highlights: Theme, language, and filter state managed with Angular Signals
Keyboard navigation and menu focus management
Automated builds and deployment with GitHub Actions

name: Angular FileTree
description: Interactive file tree with NgRx state management and an Angular Material interface. Supports adding and deleting files and simulating different users' views.
highlights: State management with NgRx actions, reducers, and selectors
Recursive operations on nested file structures
User-based filtering of files and available actions
Preserving folder expansion state when data changes

name: Slots Mini-Game
description: An Angular arcade game where the player catches falling objects. Features keyboard controls and a form for adjusting gameplay settings.
highlights: Game state managed with NgRx actions, reducers, selectors, and effects
Reactive form with validation and live gameplay settings updates
Keyboard controls, collision detection, and score tracking
Game loop, countdown timer, and simulated WebSocket feed built with RxJS
